title: Csinálnék, Csinálnál, Csinálna... The Full Pattern

sections.title: Every person, one verb
sections.content: You've now met -nék (I would) and -nál/-nél (you would) separately. csinál ("to do") shows the whole pattern together: an "n" plus á or é, then a personal ending, harmonizing back or front the way you already saw with -junk/-jünk — just two ways (back/front), not the three-way split present tense uses.

items.english: I would stay home and read.

sections.content: Compare csinálok ("I do", present) with csinálnék ("I would do", conditional) — the same -k versus -nék contrast you already saw in szeretek/szeretnék, just spelled out for every person now.
